notes.title: New Achievements & Localization Update!
notes.notes:
[p][b]🛠️ New Update Available Achievements & Localization![/b][/p][p]We're thrilled to roll out a fresh update featuring [b]six brand-new achievements[/b] for those who crave a real challenge. Whether you're taking down bosses, mastering hard mode, or dropping a nuke — your feats now come with the glory they deserve.[/p][p][b]🆕 New Achievements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reach the Boss[/p][/*][*][p]Defeat Classic Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Defeat Survivor Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Complete Classic on Hard[/p][/*][*][p]Complete Survivor on Hard[/p][/*][*][p]Use a Nuke[/p][/*][/list][p]🎯 It's time to prove your skills and collect them all![/p][hr][/hr][p]🌍 [b]Now Available in 7 New Languages:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Simplified Chinese[/p][/*][*][p]French[/p][/*][*][p]German[/p][/*][*][p]Japanese[/p][/*][*][p]Portuguese – Brazil[/p][/*][*][p]Spanish – Spain[/p][/*][*][p]Russian[/p][/*][/list][p]Enjoy the full experience in your native language!
This is part of our ongoing effort to make the game more accessible to players around the world.[/p][hr][/hr][p]💥 Update your game, check out the new challenges, and tell us what you think![/p]

notes.title: 🚨 Big Update: Relics Overhaul, Survival Mode Expansion, and some Fixes!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey Scavengers,[/b][/p][p]We just dropped a big update packed with improvements, fixes, and all-new content to take your run to the next level. Here's what’s new:[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔧 [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed flyer laser sight getting stuck[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed double-click bug when placing the first gadget[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed movement audio getting stuck[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where you couldn’t pick up a beacon near other drills[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dynamite cost not updating properly[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🎥 [b]Quality of Life[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added smooth animations when gaining / spending resources[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaner camera transitions during gameplay[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]💀 [b]Survival Mode Expanded[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Extended Survival Mode with [b]8 brutal new waves[/b][/p][/*][*][p]More chaos, more enemies, more reasons to upgrade or die[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧬 [b]Relic System Overhaul[/b][/h3][p]The whole relic flow just got a juicy makeover:[/p][list][*][p][b]Choose from 3 relics[/b] every time[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reroll relics[/b] with Oil or Scrap if you don’t like your luck[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]11 new relics[/b] — and most of them stacks[/p][/*][*][p]Time to start crafting some wild builds[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧱 [b]New Relics Include:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]💧 One-Time Oil Drop[/p][/*][*][p]🧱 One-Time Iron Drop[/p][/*][*][p]🛠 One-Time Scrap Drop[/p][/*][*][p]🔫 Faster Fire Rate[/p][/*][*][p]🛡 Armor Boost[/p][/*][*][p]🚛 Faster Truck[/p][/*][*][p]⛏ Skip Drilling[/p][/*][*][p]🐛 Driller Movement Speed[/p][/*][*][p]🛠 Faster Player Driller[/p][/*][*][p]🚀 [b]Rocket Launcher[/b] (New Weapon!)[/p][/*][*][p]☢️ [b]Nuke[/b] (New Weapon – be careful!)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Stack ‘em up, fire away, and drill deeper than ever.
This wasteland’s not gonna conquer itself.[/p][p][b]Stay oiled,[/b]
[b]— The Dead Oil Dev Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: 🛠 Steam Fest Demo Update And Player Feedback!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Gameplay & Balance[/b][/p][olist][*][p][b]New Upgrade[/b] – Add an upgrade to lower the main pipe, reducing backtracking in later stages.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shorter Run[/b] – Demo length reduced by 2 waves for a more focused experience.[/p][/*][/olist][p][b]Drilling & Driving Improvements[/b]
3. [b]Snappier Transitions[/b] – Faster and more responsive switching between driving and digging.
4. [b]Improved Driller Look[/b] – Updated visuals for the driller body.
5. [b]Smoother Hole Entry[/b] – Easier to enter drilling zones.
[/p][p][b]Combat & Clarity[/b]
6. [b]Helicopter Telegraphing[/b] – Now fires a red laser before attacking.
7. [b]Dozer Attack Marker[/b] – Clearer visual cue when the dozer’s plow is ready to strike.
8. [b]Artillery Indicator[/b] – Increased size for better visibility.
9. [b]Turret Movement Indicator[/b] – New visuals for lifting/lowering the turret.
[/p][p][b]Collection & Responsiveness[/b]
10. [b]Scrapper Radius Increased[/b] – Easier to collect enemy parts with a bigger collection zone.[/p]
